    ARB vs OP: what the numbers show

    Arbitrum's market cap of about $631.14M is 4.8 times Optimism's ($130.20M); they rank #48 and #81 of the 114 coins tracked here. Over the past year Arbitrum fell 42.9% and Optimism fell 76.6%, a gap of 33.7 percentage points in Arbitrum's favour. Optimism was the more volatile of the two over the last 30 days (103.4% annualized against 88.1%). Within the year, Arbitrum's largest fall between daily closes was 67.3% and Optimism's was 80.9%. On November 22, 2026 Arbitrum was 51.4% below its 52-week high and Optimism 80.7% below its own. In 7 of the last 12 complete months, Arbitrum did better than Optimism. Measured against Bitcoin's daily moves over 90 days, Arbitrum had a correlation of 0.52 and Optimism 0.58.
